map.药物类别（肝素/奎宁/抗生素等）+ 下降幅度 + 时间窗 + 恢复模式 加权: Weight by drug class (heparin / quinine / antibiotics, etc.) + drop magnitude + time window + recovery pattern.
map.高风险药物（肝素）改用 4Ts 单独评 HIT: For high-risk drugs (heparin), use 4Ts separately to assess HIT.
map.DITP 加权：药物类别（高4/中3/低2/其他1）、血小板下降幅度（≥80%→: DITP weighting: drug class (high 4 / moderate 3 / low 2 / other 1), platelet drop magnitude (≥80%→4, ≥50%→3, ≥30%→2, <30%→1), time window (dosing 1-14 days→3), recovery (stop 1-7 days→3), positive clinical features weighted; combined
map.例（高风险药物、PLT 180→15 即降 91.7%、起病第 5 天、停药第: Example (high-risk drug, PLT 180→15 i.e. drop 91.7%, onset day 5, recovery day 7 after stop, no extra features): class 4 + drop 4 + window 3 + recovery 3 + features 0 = 14 points (max 14, 100%) → "highly likely", stop the drug permanently at once and record the allergy history.
map.所有药物都套这个评分吗？: Do all drugs use this score?
map.肝素类不套此工具，须用 4Ts 评分单独评估 HIT（肝素诱导血栓风险特殊，即便: Heparins do not use this tool; the 4Ts score must assess HIT separately (heparin-induced thrombosis risk is special and thrombosis can occur even without very low PLT); other drugs can use this weighting for a causal first judgement.
map.下降幅度 ≥80% 为何权重最高？: Why does a ≥80% drop weigh most?
map.血小板短时间内骤降（尤其伴出血）最支持药物破坏机制；缓慢小幅下降更可能源于基础病: A rapid platelet plunge over a short time (especially with bleeding) best supports a drug-destruction mechanism; a slow small drop is more likely from the underlying disease or other factors, so drop magnitude is a core clue to causality.
map.药物诱导免疫性血小板减少症（DITP）风险评估工具，基于药物类别、血小板下降幅度: A drug-induced immune thrombocytopenia (DITP) risk assessment tool: it scores comprehensively from multi-dimensional factors — drug class, platelet drop magnitude, onset and recovery time windows, clinical features — to judge the causal link between the drug and thrombocytopenia.
